svg.aria-label: From an operator install to a shared iGPU on every node: 1. Operator: The intel-device-plugins-operator chart installs the controller and its CRDs. The controller then builds the plugin DaemonSet from a CR. 2. Select: The GPU release creates GpuDevicePlugin xe with allowIDs 0xa7a0, so only the integrated GPU is advertised. 3. Share: sharedDevNum 99 offers 99 shares of gpu.intel.com/xe per node. A pod requests one share. 4. Gate: The GPU Kustomization health-checks the CR through healthCheckExprs: desired and ready DaemonSet counts must match.
